title: Beak
blurb: The beak or bill is an external rostrum structure found mostly in birds. A beak is used for pecking, grasping, and holding, preening, courtship, and feeding young.
facts: The terms beak and rostrum are also used to refer to a similar organ in some non-avian theropods, ornithischians, pterosaurs, cetaceans, dicynodonts, rhynchosaurs, anuran...
audio_note: bird_adjacent words get no audio — there's no sound of a GIZZARD, see HANDOFF.md §6
